checkpoint.title: Use the Mail Glitch: read the glitched mail, duplicate one Antidote

events.why: Fly from Route 16 to Celadon City's Pokemon Center landing tile (48, 12)
enter Celadon Dept Store 1F and stand below the elevator door (6, 1)
ride the elevator to 4F (Wise Man Gifts)
walk to face the 4F clerk (3, 13) across counter row 12
buy 8 Retro Mail ($50 each): 5 to fill the party's mail records, 1 for proof A, 1 per duplication round, 1 spare (spec section 6)
ride the elevator back down to 1F
MIMIEN to party slot 1, where the C++ ItemDuplication gives (user decision 2 on PR #52)
slot 2 holds a Retro Mail with one word (ABRA): with mg-05's leaked record, the five fill every party mail record
slot 3 holds a Retro Mail with one word (ABRA): with mg-05's leaked record, the five fill every party mail record
slot 4 holds a Retro Mail with one word (ABRA): with mg-05's leaked record, the five fill every party mail record
slot 5 holds a Retro Mail with one word (ABRA): with mg-05's leaked record, the five fill every party mail record
slot 6 holds a Retro Mail with one word (ABRA): with mg-05's leaked record, the five fill every party mail record
MIMIEN shows the held-item mark (its Leppa Berry), the other five the mail mark
proof A: Retro Mail given to MIMIEN opens its leaked record, which must read ABRA in field 1; blank or ??? stops the run
MIMIEN holds the Antidote to copy (its Leppa Berry back to the pouch)
Retro Mail on the Items pocket's top row, the C++ ItemDuplication's start state
proof B: one round of the C++ ItemDuplication loop; the Antidote count in the bag goes up by one
the five filler mails stay on the party (user decision 5), MIMIEN holds the Antidote

metadata.notes: Spec docs/mail-glitch-use.md (PR #52) and the user's decisions there. Starts from the fork's tested mg-05 mGBA save (Route 16 (30, 6), MIMIEN holding the recycled Leppa Berry, mail index 0, record 0 = ABRA). Bag at the start: Retro Mail 1, Antidote 2; $20,788. Retro Mail: 1 + 8 - 5 - 1 - 1 = 2. Antidote: 2 - 1 given to MIMIEN + 1 duplicated = 2 in the bag (3 in all).
